mapper.select: SELECT tenant_id::text AS tenantId, audit_id::text AS auditId, actor_id AS actorId, action AS action, resource_type AS resourceType, resource_id AS resourceId, created_at AS createdAt FROM audit_record WHERE tenant_id = #{tenantId}::uuid AND resource_type = #{resourceType} AND resource_id = #{resourceId} ORDER BY created_at ASC

INSERT INTO audit_record (tenant_id, actor_id, action, resource_type, resource_id, detail) VALUES (#{tenantId}::uuid, #{actorId}, #{action}, #{resourceType}, #{resourceId}, #{detailJson}::jsonb) RETURNING audit_id::text
